is_incident.instructions: Is this a real production incident (users are affected or will be imminently), as opposed to a noisy alert, a test, or a self-healing blip?

blast_radius.instructions: Estimate how much of the user base and which functionality is affected.

criteria.definition: A small subset of users or a non-critical feature.
A whole region, a major feature, or a large fraction of users.
All users cannot complete a core flow (sign in, pay, load the app).

likely_cause.instructions: What is the most likely root cause given the evidence?

criteria.deploy: A recent code release introduced the failure.
criteria.dependency: An upstream internal service or third-party API is failing.
criteria.capacity: Resource exhaustion: CPU, memory, connections, disk, queue depth.
criteria.external: Network, DNS, cloud provider, or DDoS.
criteria.unknown: Evidence is insufficient to pick one.

page_oncall.instructions: Should the on-call engineer be paged right now (interrupting sleep if necessary)?

true.covers: Revenue-impacting or core-flow failure in prod, sustained for more than a few minutes, or actively getting worse.

false.covers: Non-prod, self-resolved, cosmetic, or can safely wait for business hours.

customer_facing.instructions: Would an end customer notice this problem directly (as opposed to only internal tooling or observability being affected)?
